title: scPASU: a pipeline to repurpose scRNA-seq data for single cell polyadenylation analysis
description:
Original source repository for scPASU, a pipeline that repurposes 3' scRNA-seq data for alternative polyadenylation analysis by generating a dataset-specific poly(A) site reference. Developed 2022-2023 at the Lerner Research Institute, Cleveland Clinic.

This repository is the source from which the release accompanying the publication (10.5281/zenodo.14498599) was derived. Please cite the Cell Reports paper.
